integrity: Analytic proof from exact monomial action, tridiagonal calculation, sparse singular-value compression and eigenvalue inertia. Standalone finite checker corroborates but does not replace infinite-dimensional proof. Public primary article consulted in full via HTML.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to classical one-complex-dimensional Gaussian Fock space and all bounded polynomial Volterra symbols g(z)=az^2+bz+c. Sharp singular-value exponents and weak critical ideals, but no exact mixed-case singular-value prefactor, no multivariable or Fock-Sobolev theorem. Originality best-knowledge; independent priority certification not performed.
title: Sharp quasi-Schatten phase transition for Fock Volterra self-commutators
